messages:
emma (AE): kickoff: EmberPay wants a short POC to validate invoice routing + agent assist. questions: golden dataset shape, scoring, timeline, and any enterprise blockers (SSO/KMS/retention). who owns?

ryan (SalesEng): I can lead scoping. target = 5 weeks from data receipt. propose intake checklist + upload checklist for customer.

priya (Presales): success metrics idea: 1) routing F1 >= 0.86 on goldens, 2) precision on vendor extraction >= 0.9, 3) end-to-end handoff to human agent < 10% failure. also capture UX latency budget.

diego (RE): infra plan: staging infra with dedicated GPU pool for POC. nightly eval job + artifact storage. will instrument token-level cost.

megan (Security): quick flag: will need SOC2 scoping doc, confirmation on customer-managed KMS for private, and data retention policy (they want zero retention for chat transcripts). send questionnaire template.

emma (AE): buyer asks about cost trade-offs: if they go dedicated reserved capacity vs hosted, what's the monthly delta? also ask about overage protections.

ryan (SalesEng): rough math: hosted = baseline per-token + ops; dedicated = lower per-token but upfront monthly reservation. i'll draft a 3-scenario table (small/med/large).

priya (Presales): golden set requirements: ~350 examples covering common intents + 50 adversarial cases + 25 OCR-noise examples. annotate: routing label + vendor span + amount span + date span. reserve 20% as blind holdout.

diego (RE): scoring pipeline: automated steps -> embedding intent similarity + token-level entity IoU -> threshold -> human adjudication for borderline (config below). example config string: `{"scorers": ["intent_cosine","entity_iou"], "intent_cutoff": 0.82, "entity_iou_cutoff": 0.75, "human_review_rate": 0.15}`

priya (Presales): prompt templates for goldens (short). keep canonical format so scoring is deterministic. example: `System: You are a routing assistant. User: {text}. Assistant: ROUTE=[AP|AR|OTHER]; ENTITIES={vendor,amount,date}`.

ryan (SalesEng): data intake: customer to upload CSV + 100 redacted PDFs. acceptance gate: if fewer than 250 total examples we shift timeline by 1 week.

megan (Security): retention note: zero retention for chat not possible on hosted tier; can support with dedicated/private — will confirm with privacy engineering. also need network diagram for private deployment.

diego (RE): regression rules: if holdout routing F1 drops > 2.0 pts after any model sync, auto-alert and suspend rollout. nightly job posts results to #poc-regressions. sample alert: `regression-watch: routing_f1 fell 2.3 -> halting rollout`.

priya (Presales): human eval plan: 100 random samples per run, 3-judge majority for accept/reject. scoring rubric: route correctness, entity completeness, hallucination presence.

emma (AE): owners: Ryan = scoping + pricing table, Priya = goldens + rubric, Diego = infra + nightly evals, Megan = security questionnaire. deliverables: draft goldens + sample scoring config + pricing scenarios by next Wed.

ci-bot: created branch `emberpay/poc-goldenset` and scaffolded `README.md` and `scoring/config.yaml`.

ryan (SalesEng): will add upload checklist to the README and a small script for CSV validation.

diego (RE): adding OCR normalization step and 30 synthetic noisy invoices as Priya suggested.

priya (Presales): one more ask: include a few multi-intent cases (invoice + refund request) in goldens so we can test routing fallback. add 20 mixed-intent examples.

emma (AE): thanks. I'll circle back with EmberPay to confirm data delivery dates and share the checklist. closing thread summary: 1) 350 goldens + adversarial + OCR noise + mixed-intent; 2) scoring config + rubric; 3) pricing scenarios; 4) security Q + retention notes. follow-ups in branch.
